content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_TO_QUIT
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you must vacate the premises located at 123 Elm Street, Eastvale Borough, State of Novaria, on or before August 30, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_CAUSE_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: You are in violation of the terms of your lease agreement by failing to pay rent as required, which has been outstanding since July 1, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._FAILURE_TO_COMPLY
content_blocks.text: If you fail to vacate the premises by the date specified above, legal action may be taken against you.
